headline: Milan student: Build AI agent workflows that plan, execute, and ship—turn local buzz into startup traction now.
why_now: With 96 GitHub activity, 92 Hugging Face engagement, and 88 news mentions, AI agents are exploding in technical depth and public awareness. study: Complete the 'Build Agents with LangGraph' tutorial series on LangChain docs (3 days)
Build and run 3 mini agent demos from recent Hugging Face Spaces (5 days)
Read 5 top GitHub trending repos in 'AI-agents' topic and fork one to experiment (4 days)
Take the 'Modern LLM Ops' course on Hugging Face and deploy an agent to Hugging Face Inference Endpoints (5 days)

build.title: Milan Agent Concierge: Multi-tool workflow that books restaurants, schedules tours, and generates personalized travel itineraries for tourists in Milan
build.description: A conversational agent that plans a complete Milan experience by calling Google Maps API, TheFork API, and Airbnb Experiences API, then produces a shareable PDF itinerary. Impressive because it demonstrates real-world tool use, API orchestration, and local relevance—all core startup skills.
deliverables: GitHub repo with modular agent code

publish: Tweet the demo link with #AIAgents #MadeInMilan and tag @lancaster_ai, @huggingface, and @MilanStartup (Day 1)
Submit to 'Awesome AI Agents' curated list on GitHub (Day 3)
Write a Medium post titled 'Building a Milan Travel Agent with LangGraph' and cross-post to Hugging Face blog (Day 5)
Pitch at Milan's weekly AI Meetup (AIMLMilano) for live feedback and networking (Week 2)
risks: Over-engineering the first version—keep it to 3 APIs and ship fast
Getting stuck on API key onboarding—use mock servers initially
Missing the local founder signal—prioritize in-person meetups over online posts
confidence: This path is battle-tested: 96/100 GitHub momentum, 95 career upside, and a clear local advantage make it a high-probability launchpad for a Milan-based AI startup.
